name: shader-voronoi
title: Voronoi
description: Voronoi cells in two colors shift and re-tessellate, with dark gaps between them, drawn in WebGL.
useWhen: You want a cellular, crystalline backdrop that shifts and re-tessellates.
A tech scene benefits from clear cell structure with dark gaps between cells.
You want the gap thickness tunable via `gap`.
avoidWhen: You want soft, structureless fog: use shader-perlin-noise or shader-simplex-noise.
You want a glow-heavy look: `glow` defaults to 0 on purpose; keep it low to avoid decorative bloom.
Busy cells would clutter dense foreground content: lower `distortion` or use a solid backdrop.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 5 colors, comma separated, spread over the cells.

variables.label: Gap color
variables.description: Color of the lines between cells.

variables.label: Glow color
variables.description: Color of the glow at cell edges; needs glow above 0.

variables.label: Steps per color
variables.description: Banding: 1 gives hard steps, higher blends them.

variables.label: Distortion
variables.description: How far the cell centers wander.

variables.label: Gap
variables.description: Thickness of the lines between cells.

variables.label: Glow
variables.description: Strength of the glow at cell edges.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the shader in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
